description: Every checkpoint of this segment anchored to Base and Solana: per height the anchor time (ts, unix seconds), gap_s since the previous anchored height, txs between them, base_tx and solana_tx (verify on basescan.org and solscan.io), state_root and check (match: Base and Solana agree; single: anchored on one chain only; mismatch: the state roots differ between Base, Solana, minepoa's copy, the fast index's copy or minepoa's /api/status root at that checkpoint; none: no root, the genesis anchor). stats has heights, last_ts, median_gap_s, max_gap_s and mismatches. Use it to check that the chain's state is anchored on time and consistently. From POAScan's stored anchors; no upstream read.

dir.description: desc (default: highest first; mismatches first for check) or asc

limit.description: maximum anchored heights to return (1 to 1000, default 100)

range.description: time range of rows and stats (default 7d)

sort.description: height (default), ts, gap, txs or check (mismatches first)

name: get_anchor_timeline
title: Anchor timeline
